value.rationale: Insertion-only repair is nontrivial because frame confluence is not monotone under arbitrary edge insertion. The theorem proves a surprising generic repairability by one edge per disjoint obstruction, complete minimum repair multiplicity, and a nondegenerate Poisson cost distribution exactly at the natural threshold. These are actionable structural facts for finite modal frame repair and random model testing, not mere relabeling of the common-neighbor count.
